themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents that perform research tasks autonomously, including data analysis, problem-solving, and executing complex workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that assist developers in writing, reviewing, and debugging code, often through natural language interaction.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad range of AI-powered tools designed to aid researchers in various aspects of their work, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles detailing AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, such as articles, reports, or transcripts, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Explores how AI is integrated into the design process for research tools, platforms, and interfaces, impacting UX and research workflows.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Discusses platforms and marketplaces dedicated to discovering, comparing, and deploying various AI tools and solutions for research.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Covers research and analysis specifically on the behavior, capabilities, limitations, and societal impact of AI chatbots.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in the recruitment process, including its impact on hiring, job displacement, and candidate screening.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles that compare, review, or rank different AI tools and platforms, often in the context of specific use cases or industries.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Covers how AI is used to gather, analyze, and act upon customer data to understand preferences, behavior, and sentiment.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
